patthana15.8:1.1: hetuṃ dassanena pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na dassanena pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana15.8:2.1: hetuṃ bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na bhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana15.8:3.1: na hetuṃ neva dassanena na bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na na hetu neva dassanena na bhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. tīṇi.
